scope: certified finite census only; no asymptotic theorem or RH claim
block_rule: for every start a, first b>a with Arb-certified nonnegative half-strength surplus, searched only through cap
theta_rule: theta=1/(4 log(start)) independently on each block
complete_gram: restricted Vasyunin formula; no unit-cell cutoff

fixed_families.greedy: midpoint-greedy over affine plus every squarefree d<stop

verdict_policy: Arb sign only; unresolved signs and uncertified Gram determinants raise RuntimeError
ordering_policy: floating conversion occurs only for deterministic greedy/extremum ordering; never for a pass/fail verdict

blocks.greedy_ordering: Arb midpoint gains; verdicts use Arb balls
